single.rationale: Ethan Allen faces sustained revenue declines (-9.1% 3-year CAGR) with deteriorating margins and profitability, indicating structural challenges in the home furnishings market. While the company maintains decent cash generation and a vertically integrated model, the sequential weakening across all financial metrics suggests cyclical headwinds that require evidence of stabilization before warranting deeper analysis.
